questions.stem: What is the name of a triangle in which only two sides have equal lengths?
questions.solution: An isosceles triangle is defined as a triangle with exactly two sides of equal length. A scalene triangle has all sides of different lengths, a right-angled triangle is defined by having one 90-degree angle, and an acute-angled triangle has all angles less than 90 degrees.

hi.stem: एक त्रिभुज का नाम क्या है जिसमें केवल दो भुजाएं समान लंबाई की होती हैं?

hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses standard Hindi mathematical terminology.

questions.stem: What is the name of a triangle in which one angle is 90 degrees?
questions.solution: A triangle with one angle measuring 90 degrees is called a right angled triangle because the term 'right' refers to the 90-degree angle. An equilateral triangle has all angles equal to 60 degrees, an isosceles triangle has two equal angles, and a scalene triangle has all angles of different measures.

hi.stem: एक त्रिभुज का नाम क्या है जिसमें एक कोण 90 डिग्री होता है?
hi.solution: एक त्रिभुज जिसका एक कोण 90 डिग्री मापता है, समकोणीय त्रिभुज कहलाता है क्योंकि शब्द 'समकोण' 90 डिग्री के कोण को संदर्भित करता है। एक समबाहु त्रिभुज में सभी कोण 60 डिग्री के होते हैं, एक समद्विबाहु त्रिभुज में दो बराबर कोण होते हैं, और एक विषमबाहु त्रिभुज में सभी कोण अलग-अलग माप के होते हैं।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the original English question and solution, with appropriate terminology used in Hindi textbooks.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a type of triangle based on angles?
questions.solution: A right-angled triangle is classified based on its angles, as it contains a 90-degree angle. Equilateral, isosceles, and scalene triangles are categorized by the lengths of their sides, not their angles. Therefore, right-angled is the correct answer.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कोणों के आधार पर त्रिभुज का प्रकार है?

questions.stem: Which of the following is a type of triangle based on sides?
questions.solution: Isosceles is a type of triangle based on the lengths of its sides, meaning it has at least two sides of equal length. Equilateral angled, right angled, and obtuse angled describe triangles based on their angles, not their sides. Therefore, isosceles is the correct answer as it is classified by side lengths.

questions.stem: In a triangle, if all three sides are of equal length, what type of triangle is it?
questions.solution: A triangle with all three sides of equal length is defined as an equilateral triangle. A right-angled triangle has one 90-degree angle, an isosceles triangle has only two equal sides, and an acute-angled triangle has all angles less than 90 degrees. questions.stem: In a triangle, if two angles are 45 degrees each, what is the measure of the third angle?
questions.solution: The sum of the angles in a triangle is always 180 degrees. If two angles are 45 degrees each, the third angle is 180 - 45 - 45 = 90 degrees. The other options do not satisfy the triangle angle sum property.
